name: hover-card-preview-stack
title: Hover Card Preview Stack
description: A compact stack of document tiles that fans out radially on hover to show detailed preview thumbnails.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Hover Fanned Card Expansion: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
